updates.summary: query-string does not drop null by default: null becomes a bare key (`page`); only undefined is dropped.
changes: TL;DR — added the actual defaults (undefined dropped, null → bare key, '' → `q=`).
Key Concepts — default example output `'q=&sort=price'` → `'page&q=&sort=price'`; `skipNull` heading/comment now says undefined is always skipped.
Why It Matters — "null is dropped by default" → null becomes a bare `?page`.
Interview Q&A — Q1 and Q3 corrected (null serializes as a bare key; a bare key parses to null, not undefined).
Common Pitfalls — unclean-filters example output now `'category&page=1&q=&sort=price'`.

updates.summary: The first-added interceptor sits closest to the network (runs last for requests, first for responses), not on the outside.
changes: Key Concepts — timing-pattern explanation rewritten: register the stamp/read pair first so it brackets the HTTP call.
Key Concepts — "outer shell" claim reversed: first-added is the innermost layer, last-added the outermost.
Interview Q&A — Q1 "first added is the outermost wrapper" → first added runs last, closest to the network; Q3 explanation aligned.
